The Misses visited the Northern Culture Museum in Niigata, Japan!

Once the residence of the wealthy Ito family, the museum showcases traditional Japanese architecture, beautiful gardens, and the rich history of the family.

Surrounded by the beauty of the gardens and historic architecture, the Misses had a wonderful opportunity to experience Japan’s traditional culture and heritage.

It was a special moment filled with the beauty of autumn in Japan! 🍁✨
